args.message: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion in deep-nested array parsing)

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in **2.9.4** (and 3.1.0). I stayed on the 2.x line (2.9.4) as the minimal-risk patch.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed** ✅
